recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12185; future geolocation extension definition changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-12185 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction requesting that the geolocation extension spelling be corrected from "lattitude" to "latitude"; Jira records it as auto-approved and applied in svn @10126.
initial_application: The imported svn @10126 commit 3d7763fc7d0a1a1921562cf73de46c53197d669e changed geolocation.lattitude to geolocation.latitude in the historical general-extensions spreadsheet and corrected the latitude/longitude text.
additional_context: The current FHIR core checkout no longer carries the geolocation definition in source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. The authoritative definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack, where the latitude and longitude slices are spelled correctly, and current core examples using the canonical geolocation extension also use url="latitude".
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the historical correction is present, no current source contains "lattitude", and the remaining authoritative geolocation definition is outside the core checkout but already correct.

related_jiras.note: A broader geolocation extension audit already on the combined branch confirms the current extension-pack ownership and Address-scoped geolocation definition.
